newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement falls to 3.612 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement falls to 3.612 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended December 2nd was 3,612,640 gallons compared with 4,818,314 gallons last week.
Imports were 536,135 gallons compared with 2,625,481 gallons the previous week, and there were 34,958 domestic receipts this week compared to none a week ago.
Retail movement was 968,575 gallons compared with 1,520,305 gallons last year, while bulk movement was 2,464,353 gallons versus 4,685,400 gallons last year.
Current season cumulative movement was 273,791,579 versus 276,698,350 a year ago.
Inventory was 41,224,268 versus 42,375,742 gallons last year.
The final total pack for the season is 202,353,371 gallons compared with 216,502,392 gallons a year ago.
